product and plan prerender audits pass

hard_invariants: Never rebuild the site from scratch when the existing architecture can be extended safely.
Never treat main as production without verifying the actual live deployment SHA first.
Never invent or infer price, availability, payment, delivery, warranty, social proof, access model, or provider terms.
Every public renderer must consume the governed public projection or an approved derivative.
Existing canonical product URLs are preserved unless an explicit migration is approved and validated.
Plan pages may exist for UX while remaining CANONICAL_PARENT/noindex until separately approved for indexing.
Media is registry-controlled; price-bearing media is a commercial claim and must be offer/revision governed.
Database changes are additive first; no destructive migration without backup, compatibility plan, and rollback.
No production deployment until preview and browser validation pass.
Replit is permanently out of scope.

current_blockers.description: Recent upgrade preview deployments were canceled/rejected by Vercel build-rate limiting. GitHub CI is green but preview/browser promotion gate is not yet satisfied.
Normalized schema and rollback SQL are prepared but production database migration must not run until secure connection and backup/restore verification are available.

next_steps.action: Make repository harness state the required starting point for every future development turn.
Connect approved media projection to one product/plan canary using the existing media subsystem, with image/video performance and accessibility gates.
Introduce ProductPage V2 for a tightly scoped canary without changing existing canonicals or global storefront behavior.
Extend existing admin for Product Family, Plan, Provider Facts, AIPS Offer, Media, Route/SEO, Preview, Publish Checklist, and History.
Expose read-only governed public product/plan/media views first; enable writes only after database migration is safely applied.
Run Vercel preview, desktop/mobile visual checks, Playwright changed-journey tests, canonical/schema/static checks, and performance budget checks.
After backup/restore validation, apply additive catalog schema and verify legacy compatibility before enabling admin writes.
Promote only after all gates are green; verify build identity, critical routes, runtime errors, SEO output, and rollback readiness immediately after deployment.
